name: Vortex Live Resin Cannon | 1.3g
description:
Vortex Jeeter Cannon Live Resin: 1.3G Joint | Sativa | Premium Flower Infused w/ Live Resin | THC

This is one Vortex that you'll love to get caught in. With a balanced high of relaxation and energy, this is the perfect sativa for a night out with good music and friends. The flavor profile of the Vortex is really a twist- with citrus, berry & grape on the dry hit, the flavor is a grape lemon candy that tastes like a custard pie.
